Ernest Bramah, Kai Lung’s Golden Hours.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/ernest-bramah/kai-lungs-golden-hours

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Ernest Bramah, the author, died 1942.
- Hilaire Belloc, the writer of the preface, died 1953.

First publication of the text used: 1922 (SE colophon: 'Kai Lung’s Golden Hours was published in 1922 by Ernest Bramah.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1922, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 2017.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom, where the text was first published): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1953, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 2024.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
